title: General Manager, Chief Manager and Peon-cum-Guard
location: Parwanoo, Solan, Baddi, Nalagarh, Himachal Pradesh
age_limit: Maximum 50 to 65 years depending on the post as on 01.04.2026
summary: Parwanoo Urban Co-operative Bank invites applications from eligible and experienced candidates for contractual positions including General Manager, Chief Manager, and Peon-cum-Guard. Interested candidates must submit their detailed bio-data via email to hr@parwanoourban.bank.in by 07th December 2026.
eligibility_bullets: General Manager: Graduate with CAIIB (both parts) and minimum 15 years of banking experience or retired from PSU/Private Sector Bank. Maximum age 62 years as on 01.04.2026.
Chief Manager: Graduate with CAIIB (both parts) and retired/VRS optee from PSU Bank or Cooperative Bank. Maximum age 65 years as on 01.04.2026.
Peon-cum-Guard: Minimum 8th standard pass, Ex-serviceman, or possessing own gun with valid gun license. Maximum age 50 years as on 01.04.2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Prepare a detailed Bio-data / Resume containing personal details, educational and professional qualifications, and employment history.
Attach self-attested copies of educational and professional qualifications along with required retirement/service certificates.
Send the complete application via email to hr@parwanoourban.bank.in latest by 07th December 2026.
